g.text: Largest known approved peak at each gauge
Fixed-lead rolling-origin curves at H1 and H16
UTC; each line links successive origins C=t−h, not a single issuance. Approved observations remain visible even without matched forecasts.
HYDRA = three-seed prediction mean; bands = min–max, not CI. Unknown hours remain gaps. First-ranked events are fixed, not selected by model error.
